integrity: Analytic theorem proof and reproducible Python 3 supplementary checks; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic homogeneous SIS with finite logit rationality and payoff advantage A+B I for A,B>0; not generic action-dependent or risk-averse behavior.
Equilibrium count, hyperbolic local stability, and local fold only; no global basins, stochastic persistence or empirical prediction.
Literature-bound originality assessment; one closely related general feedback-game publication could not be inspected in full.
title: Sharp endemic bistability frontier in an SIS epidemic with prevalence-dependent logit incentives
